body:
First independently raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Affects PR #1150, exact merge `d7d209a18b96b5d86ba31795c422e6bf439cd72d`, reviewed head `405f75ce2280dc44172ba596b9ee08513abe437c`. Parent implementation #991 remains open with its original source/publication gates and exhausted three-PR allowance; this is a distinct bounded compatibility repair, not permission to extend that allowance or publish geography.

## Confirmed defect

The installed `data/geographic-releases/current-manifest.json` selects `releases-v7-repacked-gzip.json.gz`. Its 110 release-7 membership batches each contain 450–895 membership records. The first `7-memberships-repacked-0.json.gz` contains 648 records and 898,384 decoded bytes; encoded SHA-256 is `40fc59d3a599d138b6b808a88a9e52a6642ff869098cc4a273939e6109f137ca`.

`scripts/bootstrap-geographic-release.mjs` passes every manifest batch to its recorded route without splitting rows. `publishGeographicReleases` selects all `${release.version}-` batches when a release needs staging, including the repacked files. The actual `hosted/geographic-releases.js` `stageGeographicRelease` rejects more than 250 release/membership/change rows per atomic batch, independently of its 1 MiB payload-byte limit. Consequently, a future stage/publish operation for this not-yet-published release rejects the validly hashed repacked membership transport with HTTP 400 / `At most 250 release input rows per atomic batch`. Earlier source/entity/release batches may already have succeeded before the rejection; this is not proof of any actual production write or failed live delivery.

The compatibility error survives inspected fresh main: the handler still has the 250-row gate. The original repacker intentionally partitions by a 900,000-byte payload ceiling with `row_count_cap:null`; byte-size validation alone does not satisfy the separate service row bound. Do not remove safety limits merely to make this artifact pass.

## Actual independent reproduction and limits

In the managed sparse detached review slot, executed the unchanged archived producer at `2188a6bf9a6702fccce719f36a7e40f3f53aa932` twice to distinct fresh owned outputs. Both complete 116-file outputs match each other and both retained run vintages at `99e75a1fe5836fcb26e1fad0c505170ad8464111` byte for byte; installed pointer/registry/110 batches match those outputs. Independently compared all 84,833 original/repacked membership objects with key order and sequence, all nontransport registry fields, six predecessor release definitions, 2,586 predecessor payload Git objects/modes and 2,589 retained payload objects/modes. Eight source/successor nonmembership payloads were independently decoded and whole-byte compared. These preservation checks passed. Ordered full-record SHA-256: `3b50aeb11833d8a5a4088d5a520b36eb7f0c0764814e713a794598b86b80cc85`.

Then imported the exact actual staging-handler module, verified byte-identical at the archived execution and affected merge, and passed each of the 110 checksum-verified decoded installed batches to `stageGeographicRelease` with a throwing database-access sentinel. All 110 reject with the same 400 message before any database access. A 250-membership boundary control passes that row gate and reaches the deliberate sentinel. No network requests, database operations, imports, finalizations, deployments or source edits occurred. The control establishes admission only, not successful staging. The whole ordinary bootstrap caller was inspected; it has no consumer splitting adapter.

Minimal read-only reproduction: at the exact merge, use the committed manifest resolver/decoder to select and checksum-verify `7-memberships-repacked-0.json.gz`, JSON-parse its decoded payload, and call exported `stageGeographicRelease` with a database proxy whose every property access throws. Expect the current 400 row-bound error and zero proxy accesses. With exactly the first 250 memberships, expect the proxy sentinel instead. Do not run the bootstrap CLI against any service as an audit reproduction.

## Bounded implementation and success criteria

- Correct the boundary between immutable repacked transport and bounded service requests, preserving service byte/row and transaction limits. A caller-side bounded splitter with deterministic distinct ingestion IDs is one possible approach; another reviewed additive transport successor is acceptable. Preserve every original transport file, archived producer/output/control/result, all 84,833 ordered membership objects, source/release definitions, stable IDs, predecessor relationships and supported dates. Do not rerun an archived producer in place or overwrite retained originals.
- Scope is only geographic-release membership admission in `scripts/bootstrap-geographic-release.mjs`, a focused helper/tests if required, and additive engineering evidence under `coordination/engineering/release-membership-admission-1150/`. Any server-gate change requires explicit bounded justification and review; raising/removing the 250-row cap is not the acceptance criterion. No geometry, hierarchy, ownership-grid, source authority, physical-water, history, certificate, general publisher-planner or production changes.
- Prove every emitted request obeys the actual service limits, consumes every input record exactly once in source order, and has an immutable input-bound deterministic replay identity. Preserve source/release/membership/change staging ordering. Do not reuse one parent ingestion ID for distinct request bodies.
- Demonstrate complete release-7 staging in an isolated test store or faithful local fixture using actual handler admission and full expected counts/hashes, without a live import. Demonstrate duplicate replay, interrupted partial retry, 250/251-row boundaries, long-record byte boundaries, changed-body ingestion-ID conflict, missing/reordered row rejection and unchanged source/metadata/predecessors. Keep whole-file/descriptor/evidence-budget gates and bind generated numeric results to their actual outputs and runtime/execution vintage.
- Obtain distinct exact-head code/release review. Retain transport-preservation evidence and explicit scientific/source/publication limits. No live acceptance or approval is granted here; publication remains with the designated publisher after all independent prerequisites.

## Deduplication, readiness, dependencies and ownership

Complete fresh open/closed issue/PR discovery inspected 13 pages (1,265 entries). No existing issue or later repair covers this row-count mismatch; #1215 is a closed global-gap refresh, not a service-admission repair. Full current open-PR file pagination was inspected for overlap with the two affected shared modules and new evidence prefix. #1261 is original physical-source work; #846 owns Cloudflare publication discovery/handoff; #6 retains different hierarchy corrections/publication waits; #39 is a packaging umbrella. Preserve their claims/scopes. This issue owns no live operation, does not take #991's worker ownership, and has no implementation dependency on closing source/publication #991: local transport admission can be repaired independently. Its output does not authorize release-7 publication. Run shared read-only readiness and fresh claim/overlap checks before adding ready or claiming.

All pins below resolve to the exact affected merge. Earlier discovery dates are unknown; this is the first independently verified report in this audit.

- `staging_handler`: `hosted/geographic-releases.js`, SHA-256 `9eba2ddeeb267ca09dc396225b8fe27385c1834ab6f9ebf5cb627ae38ebf1701`.
- `bootstrap_caller`: `scripts/bootstrap-geographic-release.mjs`, SHA-256 `065a64d6d3fa20dfdc36832414cf89e868d93c5551915b3331709f0385a07cc9`.
- `installed_pointer`: `data/geographic-releases/current-manifest.json`, SHA-256 `5bffef7aa5cf7f3256d648674ed66b4293ba545097bd9c32d85d8987cedc5178`.
- `installed_registry`: `data/geographic-releases/releases-v7-repacked-gzip.json.gz`, SHA-256 `08faf0b0ad3b1a26c8c7d4e1f79cd17960d064baaaad74906f92a789cd99dbc7`.
- `first_repacked_batch`: `data/geographic-releases/7-memberships-repacked-0.json.gz`, SHA-256 `40fc59d3a599d138b6b808a88a9e52a6642ff869098cc4a273939e6109f137ca`.
- `repack_producer_receipt`: `coordination/engineering/iran-pakistan-offline-integration-991-20261006-local22/repacked-release-v2/verification.json`, SHA-256 `c33bc34c9c5957cbe663c5ea558d827a170b64602d45a131d38cacab7535bd45`.
